title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Police responded to Grace Chapel in Lexington after reports of a man with a gun, causing a lockdown.
The man was found polishing a powder horn, which was mistaken for a weapon, outside the chapel.
Lexington police confirmed there was no threat and the man was an avid period reenactor.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts the Red Sox will maintain their performance and make the playoffs despite a recent hot streak.
The Red Sox have won 32 of their last 38 games, securing the second A.L. wild-card spot.
FanGraphs gives the Red Sox a 96% chance of making the playoffs, with an 83.4% chance for a wild-card berth.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game after receiving more treatment.
Abreu has hit 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, posting a .256 average in 2026.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Jake Bennett gave up four earned runs in 5.1 innings, handing the Athletics a 5-2 lead.
Boston remains 1.5 games behind the Yankees, holding firm on the second AL wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf due to an NFL procedural rule requiring approved surface testing.
The first re-installation after the World Cup failed to meet NFL lab testing protocols due to no 'E-layer' use.
The new turf will revert to the pre-World Cup version, allowed by NFL compliance standards in 2025.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, spoiling Jack Harrison's club debut.
Houston Dynamo scored through Guilherme and Agustin Resch, exploiting New England's defensive lapses.
Jack Harrison entered as a substitute in the 55th minute but couldn't turn the tide for the Revolution.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been sidelined since May with a wrist injury and is now hitting off a pitching machine.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings and throwing out a runner.
Despite injuries, Boston is on a 9-game winning streak and poised to improve with Anthony and Rutschman's returns.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' and 'Eighth Grade' among top Netflix picks for August 2026, showcasing iconic and heartfelt storytelling.
New releases include 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' on Paramount+ and 'You, Me & Tuscany' on Peacock.
Boston.com staff favorites feature 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut on July 5.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England, according to BFRO.
Boston University experts argue there's no scientific evidence supporting the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, was an advice columnist and writer of Dear Prudence and Dear Margo.
Howard's advice combined empathy with practicality, offering balanced guidance to her readers over many years.
Howard encouraged writer Meredith Goldstein to grieve but to eventually find new sources of joy and happiness.
